note: lap 11 pre-registration (template; lap 10's with the lap 11 requests). At gate main the requests the screen left out are deleted; entrance.ts resolves each set to its last redraft and fills approvedVersions at gate entrance, before any main build. Rules: docs/lap-11/runbook.md. Lines as lap 8. A request is at the ceiling when every set P >= ceilingPct, at the floor when every set P <= floorPct (raw or corrected): its verdicts are undecided. The verdict across requests needs at least minRequests requests in the rule. errors.json (after the runs) gives the corrected figures.
errorsRule: Errors rule (lap 8, plus lap 11): an expected value that contradicts the request, or an amount, date or count that does not add up, is an expectation error; so is a set step (a service step POST /responses) whose answer contradicts the request's service API (a method or path the API does not have, or a status, body or header it does not give for that method and path; an answer the request's own catch-all line covers, such as an unlisted status handled like a 5xx, does not contradict it), each with a quote of the request.
